chunks: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Ishaq narrated to us. He said: Isma'il b. Ibrahim al-Hilwani informed me. He said: Ahmad b. Mansur Bazraj narrated to us. He said: Hadiyya b. Abd al-Wahhab narrated to us. He said: Sa'd b. Abd al-Hamid b. Ja'far narrated to us. He said: Abdullah b. Ziyad al-Yamami narrated to us from Ikrima b. Ammar, from Ishaq b. Abdullah b. Abi Talha, from Anas b. Malik. He said:

The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said: We, the Banu Abd al-Muttalib, are the masters of the people of Paradise: the Messenger of God, Hamza the Master of Martyrs, Ja'far the one of two wings, Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan, al-Husayn, and the Mahdi.

key_terms.بَنُو عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ: Banu Abd al-Muttalib — the Hashimite clan, the Prophet's immediate family
key_terms.ذُو الْجَنَاحَيْنِ: The one of two wings — the title of Ja'far ibn Abi Talib, who was martyred at Mu'ta
key_terms.سَادَةُ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ: Masters/leaders of the people of Paradise — indicating highest rank in the afterlife
key_terms.سَيِّدُ الشُّهَدَاءِ: Master of Martyrs — the title of Hamza ibn Abd al-Muttalib

ai.seo_question: Who are the masters of the people of Paradise according to the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated through a chain going back to Anas ibn Malik, records the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) declaring that the Banu Abd al-Muttalib — his own clan — are the leaders of the people of Paradise. He enumerates eight figures: himself, Hamza (his martyred uncle), Ja'far ibn Abi Talib (who, according to tradition, was granted two wings in Paradise after his martyrdom), Ali ibn Abi Talib, Fatima al-Zahra, al-Hasan, al-Husayn, and the Mahdi. The inclusion of the Mahdi alongside the other members of the Ahl al-Bayt reflects the Shia theological conviction that the Mahdi is a specific figure from the Prophet's progeny who will appear at the end of times.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Ishaq narrated to us. He said: Isma`il b. Ibrahim al-Hilwani informed me. He said: Ahmad b. Mansur Bazraj narrated to us. He said: Hadiya b. `Abd al-Wahhab narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. `Abd al-Hamid b. Ja`far narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. Ziyad al-Yamami narrated to us from `Ikrama b. `Ammar from Ishaq b. `Abdullah b. Abi Talha from Anas b. Malik. He said:

The Messenger of Allah (s) said: We, the Children of `Abd al-Muttalib, are the masters of the people of Paradise: The Messenger of Allah, Hamza the Master of Martyrs, Ja`far the one of two wings, `Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan, al-Husayn, and the Mahdi.
